title: copilot
content:
# Set up GitHub Copilot in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} Use this guide to sign in to {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} and manage your account. If you already have Copilot access, sign in with that GitHub account. For a different access path, follow the [{% data variables.product.prodname_anthropic_claude %} setup](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#claude), [{% data variables.product.prodname_openai_codex %} setup](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#codex), or [bring your own model key](/docs/agent-customization/language-models.md#bring-your-own-language-model-key). These routes have their own requirements; some agent workflows without GitHub sign-in are experimental.
Complete your first coding task with an AI agent in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}. * [Start quickstart](/docs/agents/quickstart.md)
> [!NOTE] > Claude and Codex harnesses are disabled when [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} enterprise-managed settings apply](/docs/enterprise/manage-ai-settings.md#claude-and-codex-availability), even with separate provider credentials. Contact the IT team that deployed the settings to discuss access.
